title: Design: Cycle count with an untracked part looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an untracked part, part A, and a tracked part, part B, with stock.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 5.7 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Click Cycle count.
  4. Click Cancel in the count toolbar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • The toolbar shows a printer icon, a pale "Save" button, a blue "Cancel" button and "Count changes available: 200" at the right.
  • The Active and Inactive tabs still show above the toolbar.
  • Part A's row shows "Not Tracked" in light grey in both Total Qty and Count, with no count box.
  • Part B's row shows a coloured badge in Total Qty and an empty count box in Count.

Step 4:

  • The count toolbar is replaced by the normal toolbar and nothing was counted.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part), story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List)

  • S5-R12: “In Cycle count, an untracked part shows "Not Tracked" in the count column instead of count boxes, and it is never counted.”
  • S1-E1: “The tabs stay available during a Cycle count. Switching tabs before saving drops the counts typed so far, without asking, the same as changing the search or a filter during a count.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Untracked part in Cycle count | "Not Tracked" | In the count column, in place of the count boxes”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
